name: Rohan Deshmukh
bio: Competitive programmer (Candidate Master on CF), GSoC mentor, and campus coding lead. Passionate about graph theory and microservices.

name: Ananya Kulkarni
bio: Lead vocalist for university rock band 'Tarang'. Trained in Hindustani classical for 9 years and performed at 20+ collegiate fests.

name: Kabir Sen
bio: Beat producer with 500k+ streams on Spotify. Specialized in Indian Lo-Fi and drill rhythms using FL Studio and Ableton Live.

name: Tanvi Verma
bio: Choreographer for 'V13' western dance crew, winner of Mood Indigo 2024. Loves breaking down complex urban footwork into easy 8-counts.

name: Vikramaditya Rao
bio: Varsity basketball captain, national athlete, and fitness mentor. Specializes in plyometrics, court agility, and bodyweight mechanics.

name: Meera Nambiar
bio: Product designer and digital illustrator. Designed UI design systems for startup incubation batches and created major fest visual identities.

name: Arjun Sundaram
bio: Director of campus photography society. Shot covers for collegiate cultural magazines and freelance projects for live concert stages.

name: Sahil Sheikh
bio: Top 500 Radiant player in Valorant APAC and collegiate esports lead. Coaching student squads to win regional LANs and scrims.

name: Pooja Banerjee
bio: Full-stack engineer building open-source developer tooling and leading hackathon sprint teams across collegiate developer circles.

name: Devanshu Pillai
bio: FIDE rated chess player (Elo 2080) and varsity chess captain. Passionate about breaking down chess tactics, endgames, and intuition.
